Explosion Near Manipur Congress Leader's Home, No Injuries Reported

An explosion occurred outside the residence of the Congress Legislature Party leader in Thoubal, Manipur. No injuries or significant damage were reported. The incident took place on a date not specified in the coverage. The Congress party described the event as an "attack on democracy." Authorities have not publicly stated the cause or identified any suspects.
